summary: Sprint M24 · TournamentBasicsPanel end-to-end verified. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass (create MPCA inter_div, create Division inter_district, create pre_camp, PATCH /setup-meta, GET /progress derivation for tournament AND camp flavours, 404 handling). Frontend: All persona-gated Type-Picker checks pass — MPCA Secretary sees EXACTLY the 3 expected cards (bcci_staging, away_participation, inter_div); Division Secretary sees EXACTLY the 8 expected cards (inter_district, inter_div_travel, pre_camp, reciprocal, coaching_camp, vacation_camp, inter_school, inter_club); Match Official has NO new-tournament-btn. Step 2 form renders all required elements (type-badge, name-select with 13 options for inter_div = 11 + Other + placeholder, trophy/fy/format/host/start/end/notes inputs). TournamentBasicsPanel (`panel-basics`) renders with basics-category, basics-age, basics-teams (with team-add form), basics-grounds (with ground-add form) and basics-save-btn for regular tournaments; and with basics-player-group (with player-group-input + player-count) instead of basics-teams for camp types (pre_camp). Adding 2 teams + 1 ground → save → reload → all values persist. Same for camp player-group + player-count → persist across reload. Progress bar: Setup phase shows 4/7 · IN PROGRESS at 21% after basics saved; expanding setup phase renders all 7 sub-steps as data-testid=progress-step-{created|basics|teams|grounds|input_vars|accepted|calendar}. RBAC regression: /access-control link visible in secretary sidebar, hidden for division-secretary. All acceptance criteria for M24 met.
action_items: (Minor · spec-alignment) The review request states 'Percent ≥ 40%' after basics is saved, but the derivation is 4/19 = 21% because only 4 of the total 19 steps across 5 phases are done. To hit ≥40% the user must ALSO save input_vars, get acceptance (auto Not_Required only for MPCA-hosted), and lock the calendar — i.e., ALL 7 setup sub-steps + at least one squad step. Either (a) update the spec to '≥20%' after just basics, or (b) reweight the percent to count only the current-phase steps (4/7 = 57%). No code change strictly required.

(Minor) DELETE /api/tournaments/{tid} returns 405 (Method Not Allowed); this iteration created TEST_M24-prefixed tournaments that cannot be cleaned via API. Consider adding a soft-delete or admin cleanup endpoint (previously flagged).
critical_code_review_comments: TournamentBasicsPanel.jsx uses Date.now() to generate row ids in-browser — collision risk when adding two rows in the same millisecond (unlikely but possible). Consider uuid or an incrementing counter.

TournamentBasicsPanel.jsx line 33: `setup_meta` spread happens once at initial state; if the parent `tournament` prop is later refreshed with a newer setup_meta, the local `meta` state will not resync. This is OK because the parent only reloads after save (via load()) and unmounts the panel, but note the pattern for future changes.

tournament_workspace.py `patch_setup_meta` does a hard $set of the whole `setup_meta` dict — no field-level validation or size cap. A malicious client could store arbitrary keys. Consider narrowing to a Pydantic model with allowed keys (category, age_group, teams[], pools[], grounds[], player_group, player_count).
TournamentBasicsPanel.jsx uses window.alert on save error — replace with an inline error banner (consistent with earlier iter34-36 feedback across other panels).
test_credentials: 6 persona chips on /login + login-submit-btn; no passwords.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_M24 tournaments were created via API and left in place (DELETE endpoint returns 405). TIDs: 93a78c74-40fd-4870-a737-a2843c8029aa (inter_div), d11bc406-71c1-419c-a4c2-eaf34bc3b25b (pre_camp). The pytest suite creates 3 more TEST_M24 records per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: M24 fully green. Backend endpoints: PATCH /api/tournaments/{tid}/setup-meta and GET /api/tournaments/{tid}/progress work as designed. Setup phase = 7 sub-steps; derivation logic in tournament_workspace.py lines 238-244 correctly interprets teams OR pools OR player_group as satisfying the 'teams_set' condition (critical for camps). Frontend TournamentBasicsPanel switches between team-grid and player-group block based on CAMP_TYPES list. Progress percent is total-steps-based (out of 19 across all phases) so 'basics saved only' yields ~21% — clarify with product if this needs re-weighting.
